# Chapter 11: AI Ethics and Best Practices

## Why AI Ethics Matter for Small Business

As you integrate AI into your business, you're not just making technology decisions—you're making ethical decisions that affect your employees, customers, and community. The choices you make about how to deploy AI reflect your values and can have real impacts on people's lives.
